old_caption: The video depicts a car crash test conducted in an indoor facility. A blue hatchback car is positioned to collide with a rigid barrier. The car's front end deforms significantly upon contact, with the hood crumpling and the front bumper breaking apart. Debris flies off the vehicle as it collides with the barrier. Inside the car, two crash test dummies are seated, one in the driver's seat and another in the passenger seat. Both dummies are wearing orange safety suits and helmets. As the car impacts the barrier, the dummies are visibly jolted, indicating the force of the collision. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the entire event from a side perspective. The background shows the interior of a testing facility, with visible structural elements like beams and pipes. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the details of the car's deformation and the movement of debris.

The background shows the interior of a testing facility, with visible structural elements like beams and pipes. caption: The video depicts a side view of a blue hatchback in a dim crash-test hall, its front folded against a fixed silver-grey barrier at the right edge. The crush deepens steadily as the hood, fender and A-pillar fold inward while the windshield cracks and shatters further. The front wheel is shoved rearward into its arch, the tire and surrounding sheet metal compressing. The lower side molding tilts slightly downward toward the front. Inside, an orange dummy in the driver's seat drifts forward, head and torso moving toward the steering column. A second, darker dummy sits faintly in the rear. A trail of small white dots appears near the dummy's head and accumulates across the window. Fine bright debris particles hang in the air above the crumpled front, drifting slowly. The barrier and beams remain fixed as the car continues to move into them. The clip ends with the front still pressed into the barrier and the collapse continuing.

draft_caption: The video depicts a side view of a blue hatchback in a dim crash-test hall, its front folded against a fixed silver-grey barrier at the right edge. The crush deepens steadily as the hood, fender and A-pillar fold inward while the windshield shatters further. The front wheel is shoved rearward into its arch, the tire deforming and the rim rotating. The lower side molding tilts slightly downward toward the front, showing a small forward pitch of the cabin. Inside, an orange dummy in the driver's seat drifts forward, head and torso moving toward the steering column. A second, darker dummy sits faintly in the rear. A trail of small white dots appears near the dummy's head and accumulates across the window. Fine bright debris particles hang in the air above the crumpled front, drifting slowly. The barrier and beams stay fixed, so the motion belongs to the deforming car, not the camera. The clip ends with the front still pressed into the barrier and the collapse continuing.
